about: The third-party components inside an APK of Prose Plow, maintained by hand. The build (generate<Variant>ThirdPartyNotices in app/build.gradle.kts) fails unless the jvm-library entries are exactly the runtime classpath; ThirdPartyNoticesTest ties the models, llama.cpp and the NDK to the build's pins and this list to NOTICES.txt, which is the text the app shows. README.md, "Licence and third-party notices", says what to do when either fails.

licences/Apache-2.0.txt.taken_from: the text as published at apache.org (byte for byte the COPYING file of Guava and the LICENSE of Kotlin, JSpecify, FlatBuffers and kotlinx.collections.immutable)

licences/Apache-2.0-WITH-LLVM-exception..taken_from: the libc++ block of toolchains/llvm/prebuilt/<host>/NOTICE in Android NDK r29, which is libcxx/LICENSE.TXT of the LLVM project

licences/MIT.txt.taken_from: LICENSE of llama.cpp at the pinned commit, with its copyright line replaced by the placeholder of the SPDX text; the permission notice is word for word the one of every MIT component here

licences/BSD-3-Clause-R8.txt.taken_from: the LICENSE file inside com.android.tools.build:builder:9.3.3, which embeds R8 9.3.28 (the first licence in that file)

licences/BSD-2-Clause-bionic.txt.taken_from: the header of libc/arch-common/bionic/crtbegin_so.c in platform/bionic (main branch), without the comment markers

licences/BSL-1.0.txt.taken_from: license/third_party/boost_LICENSE.txt of JetBrains/kotlin at tag v2.4.21

The card counts the weights cast to 16-bit floats as still being Peacebell, and the name is used in this app with the permission of the model's author.
